nodes.label: Build Memory Protocol
nodes.rationale: Before planning or changing a component, read docs/memory/INDEX.md and run mem find over the touched paths and keywords. On any error, search failures by the error text first and do not retry an approach a failure record says failed unless you have a new root cause. A record is a hint until its cited files still match.

nodes.label: Evidence Ledger
nodes.rationale: Checks run through pb.py run --task so results land in the evidence ledger: 'done' means passing evidence exists, not that code was written.
